producer: analysis/chambers_fetch.py (fetch_status.json; docs into external/causal_chambers_docs/), analysis/chambers_map.py (mapping.json, mapping_table.csv), analysis/chambers_validate.py (one_layer_deep.json), analysis/chambers_sample.py (sample/), analysis/rep09_ges.py (rep09_ges.json); shared I/O in analysis/chambers_io.py
orientation_rule: rep09_ges.json follows the Causal Chambers authors (causal_discovery_iid.ipynb cell 27): every DAG in the estimated CPDAG is enumerated (sempler.utils.all_dags) and scored; the reported quantity is the per-DAG list and its range, no single orientation is chosen

metric_defs.precision_per_dag: for each DAG in the estimated CPDAG: |estimated directed edges that are true directed edges| / |estimated directed edges| (authors' cell 10)
metric_defs.recall_per_dag: for each DAG in the estimated CPDAG: |estimated directed edges that are true directed edges| / |true directed edges| (authors' cell 10)
metric_defs.n_dags: number of DAGs in the estimated CPDAG's equivalence class
metric_defs.seconds: wall time of the ges.fit_bic call

rep09_ges.json.note: truth = causalchamber 0.2.8 graph('lt','standard') induced on the authors' 20 variables; data = uniform_reference of lt_interventions_standard_v1 (observational reference, 10000 rows). The 'ours' block exists only when the verified zip is present; this version holds the reported numbers and the data-free metric/truth check.

one_layer_deep.json.note: hypothesis tests (KS, Holm at 1%) on validation experiments, not discovery scores

sample/.note: input data for discovery runs (regime D+I when used with targets); no scores
